query: INSERT INTO secret_usage_binding (id, consumer_type, consumer_id, field_key, owner_scope_type, owner_scope_id, secret_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (consumer_type, consumer_id, field_key) DO UPDATE SET secret_id = EXCLUDED.secret_id, owner_scope_type = EXCLUDED.owner_scope_type, owner_scope_id = EXCLUDED.owner_scope_id, updated_at = now()
